review_status: Draft: fixed-reference counting, finite units, B010/B024 pairing and whole-task Qwen grading implemented offline; real judge acceptance, formal rule approval and independent audit remain separate
scoring_workflow: Qwen marks every task cell; program validates coverage and computes scores; automatic workflow ends; humans inspect correction reports externally without an approval-file gate

result.supplementary_statistics.text_basis: Whole-field comparison preserves all assertions; only whitespace and equivalent comparator glyphs are normalized.

field_granularity: one whole scientific field; compound content is not split; identifiers and declared provenance excluded; references remain scientific
null_policy: Fixed-version gold, scientific cells: BOTH sides blank => not_scored, with no TP, FP or FN; nonempty gold with a blank or absent prediction => missing (FN); blank gold with nonempty submitted scientific content => extra (FP). Null and empty or whitespace-only strings are blank and are not reference items. Zero, false and explicitly written scientific states including NR/NE remain content. Do not amend the fixed reference.
compound_policy: whole-field all-or-nothing: all required content and attributions must match; no subitem credit
numeric_policy: Establish the same object, quantity, time, direction, comparator and unit. Test numeric equality first. For unequal continuous quantities, round only a finer prediction once to the source-supported reference precision (ROUND_HALF_UP, ties away from zero). Require the rounded prediction to equal the original reference. If the source precision is unknown, require exact equality. Counts, denominators and identifiers require exact agreement. Apply the rule to corresponding components, preserving units, signs, bounds, states and all other assertions. Score the whole field once. When rounding, record both original values, the source locator, the target precision and the rounded value.
identity_policy: Qwen first establishes one-to-one scientific object correspondence using object-level accessions, source-defined native labels or unique predeclared identity groups. Never use row order, local ID equality, outcome equality alone or score-maximizing ties. Judge conflicting descriptions from the supplied fixed reference, task and permitted context; genuinely unresolved identities remain uncertain with reasons. Exact duplicates remain surplus predictions. Human inspection follows automatic grading outside the program and is not a prerequisite for Qwen's judgment.
text_policy: Qwen judges complete scientific meaning in the fixed-reference, task and record context; different wording can be correct without an exact textual match or a prelisted alias. Preserve every required assertion, scientific state, association, numerical value, precision and approved quantity-scoped unit rule. A wrong or incomplete whole field is incorrect; genuinely unresolved meaning stays uncertain with a reason. Human inspection takes place after automatic grading outside the program, without an approval-file gate.

unit_catalog.scope: Approved finite exact equivalences, used only through explicit quantity bindings after independent object alignment. Embedded in the scoring policy for immutable replay; formal scientific rules remain unfrozen.

fixed_duration.requires: Same duration and temporal anchor; never equate distinct visits or calendar cutoffs.

molar_concentration.requires: Same analyte, chemical form and concentration basis.

mass_concentration.requires: Same analyte, chemical form and concentration basis; do not convert mass to molar concentration.

daily_exposure_duration.requires: Same daily regimen; do not confuse per-day exposure with total exposure.

event_rate_spelling.requires: Same event definition and denominator basis.

not_automatically_equivalent: calendar month versus 30 days; calendar year versus 365 days
mg/kg body weight versus mg/kg diet or dry matter
mass concentration versus molar concentration requiring a molecular mass
% versus % w/v versus % v/v versus % w/w versus percentage points
raw scale points versus T-score or standardized effect
person-time event rates versus participant counts or event counts
Pa/kPa versus psi or mmHg without an approved exact rule
unit_catalog.coupled_content: Convert value and unit consistently. Review all dependent bounds, intervals and own statistics in a whole compound field. Fields remain one all-or-nothing scoring item. Do not let scalar conversion silently exempt unchanged companion content.
unit_catalog.unsupported_forms: Preserve ranges, inequalities, compound ratios, unlisted spellings and ambiguous quantities as whole fields. Qwen judges them under the supplied exact quantity-compatible rules; genuinely unresolved cases stay uncertain with reasons for later external inspection. A parser limitation alone is not a scientific error.
formal_freeze_requirements: Documented scientific approval of the final scientific rule package, beyond this previously approved finite catalog
Quantity-aware scorer integration rather than one global canonical unit
Tests for equivalent conversions and context or denominator mismatches
Bind rules to the exact frozen task, reference and scorer identities

condition.factor_value.basis: Approved finite catalog: compare the independently aligned sample and experimental factor, preserving target and temporal context.

result.result_value.basis: Approved finite catalog: compare the same independently aligned population, measure, time, statistic and analysis basis; preserve whole supplementary assertions.
